pageDesc.hikayeAtolyesi: Import, review, publish and monitor Reading World stories.

hikayeAtolyesi.title: Story Workshop
hikayeAtolyesi.giris: Stories are not written in the panel; packages prepared in the workshop pipeline are imported, reviewed and published here. Publishing needs two AI reviews and a human approval, and the person who created a story cannot publish it.
hikayeAtolyesi.kurulumYok: The Reading World database layer is not installed in this environment yet. This section works once it is.

hatalar.demo: Nothing can be saved in demo mode.
hatalar.yetki: Administrator permission is required for this action.
hatalar.genel: The action could not be completed. Try again later; if it persists, check the record.
hatalar.YAYIN_KAPISI: To publish, Agent A and Agent B reviews must be "pass" and the human decision "approved". Save the review and try again.
hatalar.DORT_GOZ: Four-eyes rule: the creator cannot publish or approve their own record. Another administrator must do it.
hatalar.SURUM_DEGISMEZ: The content and review of a published version cannot be changed. Import a new version instead.
hatalar.GECERSIZ_GECIS: This status change is not allowed.
hatalar.SURUM_BULUNAMADI: Version not found. Refresh the list.
hatalar.HIKAYE_BULUNAMADI: Story not found. Refresh the list.
hatalar.BAD_AD: The name must be 1 to 80 characters.
hatalar.BAD_ID: The id may only contain lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
hatalar.BAD_ETIKET: The label must be 2 to 120 characters.
hatalar.BAD_KANIT: Evidence level must be A, B, C or D.
hatalar.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
hatalar.EN_FAZLA_BES: At most 5 values can be selected.
hatalar.TEKRARLI_DEGER: The same value was selected more than once.
hatalar.SURUM_SILINEMEZ: Only draft or archived versions can be deleted. Move a version under review back to draft or archive first.
hatalar.OTURUM_VAR: Children have already read this content, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
hatalar.SURUM_YAYINDA: A published version cannot be deleted. Archive it first.

liste.sinirUyari: The first {limit} versions were loaded. Theme and value filters only apply to loaded versions; narrow by status or grade.
liste.bos: No stories imported yet. Upload the first package in the "Import" section.
liste.suzgecBos: No version matches these filters. Loosen the filters.

detay.dortGoz: Four eyes: creator {olusturan}, reviewer {inceleyen}. The creator and the publisher cannot be the same person; the server enforces this.
detay.yayinaHazir: All three reviews are complete; ready to publish.
detay.yayinaHazirDegil: To publish, Agent A must be "Pass", Agent B "Pass" and the human decision "Approved".
detay.denetimKilitli: The review of a published or archived version cannot be changed.
detay.onceKaydet: Save the review first, then publish.
detay.yayinOnay: "{baslik}" will be published. Published content cannot be changed; the previous publication of the same story is archived. Continue?
detay.arsivOnay: The published version will be archived and hidden from children. Continue?

onizleme.not: The preview uses fixed sample names: hero "{kahraman}", companion "{yoldas}". No real child name is used. Dashed labels are template placeholders.

iceAktar.aciklama: Upload or paste the story package (JSON) from the workshop. A dry run comes first: nothing is written, the package is only validated. If you confirm, it is saved as a draft; the status and human approval written in the package are ignored.
iceAktar.yer: Paste the package JSON text here
iceAktar.cokBuyuk: The file is too large (about 1.5 MB at most). Check the package file.
iceAktar.jsonHatali: The text is not valid JSON. Check brackets and quotes.
iceAktar.gecersizNot: Nothing was written. Fix the errors in the workshop and upload the package again.
iceAktar.gecerli: Package is valid. Not written yet.
iceAktar.mevcut: The same story with the same content is already saved; no new version will be created.
iceAktar.yazildi: The package was saved as a draft.
iceAktar.yazNot: If you confirm, the package is written as a draft version and its goals are linked to the unapproved catalog. Review is required to publish.

ayarlar.aktifOnay: Reading World will be turned on. If pilot grades or allowed accounts are set, only they see it; otherwise all students do. Continue?
ayarlar.aktifKapali: Currently off. Only allowed accounts and administrators can preview.
ayarlar.pilotHepsi: No grade selected: all grades once the flag is on.
ayarlar.izinliCok: At most 200 accounts can be entered.
ayarlar.izinliGecersiz: IDs must be valid UUIDs. Write one ID per line.
ayarlar.aralik: {ad} must be a whole number between {min} and {max}.
ayarlar.onunKati: {ad} must be a multiple of 10 (0, 10, 20 or 30).
ayarlar.xpToplam: Completion XP plus accuracy bonus XP can be 30 at most.

aktif.aciklama: Off by default. While off, Reading World does not appear in the child app.

pilot_siniflari.aciklama: Students in the selected grades get access. If none is selected, everyone has access while the flag is on.

izinli_kullanicilar.aciklama: IDs of accounts that can see in-review stories even while the flag is off. One UUID per line, up to 200.

okuma_gunluk_hikaye.aciklama: Number of different stories a free user can start per day. Trial and premium are unlimited; questions are never restricted.

okuma_pdf_aylik_ucretsiz.aciklama: Number of different stories a free user can download as PDF per month.

xp_tamamlama.aciklama: Awarded on the first completion of a story. A multiple of 10.

xp_dogru_bonus.aciklama: Added when the accuracy threshold is met. A multiple of 10; together with completion XP at most 30.

xp_gunluk_hikaye_tavani.aciklama: The most stories that can earn XP in one day.

dogru_orani_esik.aciklama: An accuracy above this percentage earns the bonus XP.

min_n.aciklama: The fewest students or votes needed to show a value in scorecards and summaries. Below it, "no observation" is shown.

saatlik_baslatma_siniri.aciklama: The most sessions one student can start per hour.

sozluk.aciklama: Add or update a theme, subject, Maarif value or umbrella value. Deactivated themes and subjects are rejected in new packages.
sozluk.anahtarDeger: The value key must be between D1 and D20.
sozluk.anahtarKod: The key must start with a lowercase letter and may contain lowercase letters, digits and underscores (2–40 characters).
sozluk.adGerekli: The name must be 1 to 80 characters.
sozluk.pasifNot: An inactive entry cannot be used in new packages.

hedef.aciklama: Add, update or approve a goal. Goals in packages are linked to the unapproved catalog on import.
hedef.idGecersiz: The id must consist of lowercase letters, digits and underscores (80 characters at most).

kanitDuzeyleri.A: A · verified against the official curriculum
kanitDuzeyleri.B: B · editor suggestion under an official theme
kanitDuzeyleri.C: C · general pedagogy, no official match

hedef.etiketGecersiz: The label must be 2 to 120 characters.
hedef.dortGoz: Four eyes: the person who created the goal cannot approve it. If the type or label of an approved goal changes, the approval is dropped.

karne.aciklama: Per-story monitoring: completion, children's rating, drop-off page and question item analysis. If the number of students who started is below the minimum, no value is shown; "no observation" does not mean zero.
karne.hikayeYok: No stories for the scorecard yet. Import a package first.
karne.yetersiz: No observation: {baslatan} students started this version; at least {min} are needed for metrics.

bosluk.aciklama: For the selected grade, shows how many stories are published at each theme and Maarif value intersection. Cells with zero are content gaps.
bosluk.sozlukBos: There is no active theme or value in the dictionary; the map cannot be drawn.
bosluk.ozet: {bos} of {toplam} intersections have no published story.
bosluk.okuma: Cell: published story count. "+n" is the in-review count. Column headers are Maarif value codes (hover to see the name).
bosluk.okunanHikayelerYok: No stories to show: a story appears only when at least {min} different students have read it.
bosluk.turYok: No genres to show: a genre needs at least {min} different students.
bosluk.hedefYok: No items to show: an item needs at least {min} different students.
bosluk.hedefOgrenenSayisi: {ogrenci} students encountered it · {ogrenen} recognised or recalled it
bosluk.ogrenciAciklama: Reading summary of a single student. Shown only for students in your class whose parent has consented to sharing reading data.
bosluk.rizaYok: This student's parent has not consented to sharing reading data; no summary is shown.
bosluk.rizaGeriCekildi: This student's parent withdrew consent; no summary is shown.
bosluk.ogrenciYetkisiz: You do not have access to this student's summary.
bosluk.tabloBaslik: Published stories per theme and value intersection for grade {n}

araclar.not: Editing creates a new draft version; the published version stays unchanged until the new version passes review and is published. Content that has been read is archived, not deleted.
araclar.oturumluIpucu: This version was read in {n} sessions and cannot be deleted. Archive it if needed.
araclar.silmeIpucu: Only draft or archived versions can be deleted. Archive a published version first.
araclar.surumSilMetin: Version {no} of "{baslik}" will be permanently deleted.
araclar.hikayeSilMetin: "{baslik}" and all its versions will be permanently deleted. The linked production slip returns to a draft brief. A story with a published version or reading sessions cannot be deleted.

duzenle.aciklama: Saving adds your changes as a new draft version. When the new version passes review and is published, it replaces the previous one.
duzenle.yerTutucuNotu: Hero, word and scene placeholders are not changed here; only plain text is editable.
duzenle.gecersiz: The package did not pass validation. Fix the issues below.
duzenle.dogrulamaTamam: The package is valid. Use "Save as new draft version" to save it.
duzenle.ayniIcerik: This content is already saved (version {no}); no new version was created.
duzenle.kaydedildi: Saved: new draft version {no}. Open it from the list for review and publishing.

istatistik.aciklama: Overall usage of published stories. This is admin data: totals are shown, individual children are not.
istatistik.dogrulukNotu: Correct answers / questions in completed sessions

okumaSinif.aciklama: Class story-reading summary. Class totals contain no child names and need at least 3 students; a single student's summary opens with the selector below, only for students whose parent has given consent.
okumaSinif.hata: The reading summary could not be loaded. Try again.
okumaSinif.yetersiz: No observation: the summary is hidden because fewer than {min} students read stories in this period.
okumaSinif.zorlanilanYok: No goals to show: at least {min} students must miss a goal for it to appear.
okumaSinif.temaYok: No themes to show: a theme needs at least {min} different students.
okumaSinif.not: Rates are calculated as correct answers / questions answered. A value is not shown for a question type or goal without at least {min} students.
